rationale: The 68 archived cores establish the comparison baseline. The live proposal affects 27 of those boards, and the exact native audit replays all 49 reviewed additions there. The 33 additional opening pairs and 16 additional target pairs occupy distinct unused pair keys and use existing projected concepts. For example, Sucevița with Voroneț leads to the recognizable shared category Mănăstire while the Patrimoniul mondial UNESCO target still requires its original par. I projected the archived cores to recipe IDs, checked each of the 97 listed routes on the affected boards, and computed the minimum craft count before and after additions for each affected board. Every route and par is preserved. The live maxima are eight productive starter pairs, ten target-producing pairs, two outputs per pair, six additions and 24 recipes per board. All core and addition edge records reconcile with the proposal. Archived-to-current node snapshot differences are confined to aliases and degree; concept identities, player-visible labels, seeds and targets agree. The current C1 pack, rankings, derived catalog, quick catalog and world catalog bindings match the audited inputs. The audit reports preserved graph provenance and unchanged cores, routes and par. The proposal has no diagnostics.
